newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawian insurance firm to list on November 11.
newsitem.headline: Malawian insurance firm to list on November 11.

text.p: Malawi's state-owned National Insurance Company Ltd (NICO) will list on the Malawi Stock Exchange on November 11 after the Malawi Development Corporation (MDC) sells 15 percent of its stake.
Speaking at the launch of the public offer of some 15 million shares on Thursday night, NICO managing director Felix Mlusu said the offer would be open for three weeks before the company listed.
The company is offering 15 million of its 100 million shares at $0.13 per share.
NICO is 54.9 per cent owned by Press Corporation Limited, which is controlled by former president Kamuzu Banda, while the MDC currently holds a 20 percent stake.
South Africa's Guardian National Insurance Company owns a 25.1 percent stake.

In 1995, NICO declared $600,000 (Malawi Kwacha 9 million) in dividends compared to $400,000 (MK6 million) in 1994 after taxed profit of $1.3-million (MK19 million) and $800,000 (MK12 million) in 1995 and 1994 respectively.
